bio.text: Aaron Guckian is the Republican nominee for Governor of Rhode Island in the November 3, 2026 election, having advanced from the September 9, 2026 primary.
He ran for lieutenant governor in 2022, losing to Democrat Sabina Matos, and is an East Greenwich native who was a special assistant to Gov. Don Carcieri.

According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes work as a development officer for the Rhode Island Foundation, a vice president at Bank Newport and an officer at The Washington Trust Company.
Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Connecticut College, a master's degree in music from Rhode Island College and an MBA from Johnson and Wales University.

sources.title: Beyond the Podium: Republican Guckian defends resume in run for governor
